fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 8: genesis slice, the composed context an agent reads for a node or a change set, in the ten agreed sections, with inheritance down the tree and a token budget enforced by fixed cuts, as a pure internal/slice package over a reader fed by the index or a what-if model. Decided (D1-D17, agent wording accepted by the owner): slice takes a ref for a node slice, or no ref for a change slice of the effective change set; as-is and to-be read the index and what-if is computed, with the 50 ms budget covering only as-is and to-be; the budget measures the bytes actually printed, in markdown or JSON, with tokens as ceil(bytes / 4); constraints apply only through constrains links, a constraint on a tree root applies below it marked with its root, and an unlinked constraint applies nowhere; short IDs are the shortest unique prefix of at least six characters; a change slice touches its operations' target nodes and the node ends of the links it creates or retires; items read the statement field, and evidence status is derived from verifies links; cuts go full, then brief, then count, from section 10 upward, never touching Focus, Constraints or Open questions, with a footer naming the command for what was cut; current decisions are live and not superseded, open questions are unanswered, blocking ones first; neighbours and in-flight sections; over-budget output prints everything required, notes the overage and exits 0; a typed JSON shape pinned by the describe golden; TDD with goldens and a property that index-built equals model-built. Revised by the orchestrator under the owner's authorization: D1's default view now follows the rule shared with task 7. Left open: a fast incremental what-if.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 8: slice
